dedupe_keys.name: li bim bdi agent model of building occupant behaviour on ifc building models

description: Li-BIM simulates how the occupants of a building behave, to help designers account for users when they design. It reads the building from an IFC building information model and gives occupants a cognitive model with a Belief-Desire-Intention architecture, aiming at a model that can serve thermal, air quality, lighting and other studies, not one use only. It was implemented on the GAMA platform by Patrick Taillandier, Franck Taillandier and Alice Micolier and published on CoMSES in August 2017. Coverage: any building available as IFC. Access: free GAMA code on CoMSES. Licence: AFL-3.0. Caveats: a research model; coupling to a physics simulator is left to the user. Simulation uses are occupant schedules and actions for building performance simulation and for testing designs of offices, schools and hospitals with realistic users. Related records: the IFC standard and the office electricity consumption agent-based model.
name: Li-BIM: BDI agent model of building occupant behaviour on IFC building models
outputs: Simulated occupant activities and movements inside the building
